en: Vintage multi-view sepia postcard showing four photographs of a large hospital complex and its associated buildings. The upper left view is a panoramic shot of extensive institutional buildings nestled against wooded hills, labeled as a state hospital. The upper right view shows a multi‑story building in a wooded area, labeled as a convalescent home. The lower left view focuses on a main multi‑story block with a formal entrance gate, captioned as the administration building. The lower right view displays a domed church with classical detailing beside more hospital buildings, labeled as a church of the Holy Redeemer. The main heading identifies the overall location as Graz and the state hospital (Landeskrankenhaus).
